footerNote: Net income here is the $476M attributable to common stockholders; total net income was $477M, with $1M belonging to noncontrolling interests. Segment figures are from Palantir's Q3 2025 10-Q, rounded to the nearest $M.
oneTimers: Stock-based compensation and related employer payroll taxes of about $208M sit inside cost of revenue and operating expenses; excluding them, adjusted operating income was $601M (a 51% margin) instead of $393M, and adjusted EPS was $0.21 vs $0.18 GAAP.
otherDetail: Interest income of $60M on Palantir's cash pile, plus $27M of other income, net — a net +$87M below operating profit.

segments.name: Government
segments.note: Software for the U.S. military, intelligence agencies and allied governments — U.S. government revenue alone grew 52% to $486M.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.note: Software for companies — U.S. commercial revenue jumped 121% to $397M as businesses raced to put AI to work, and U.S. commercial remaining deal value hit $3.63B, up 199% YoY.

takeaways.text: U.S. commercial revenue more than doubled to $397M, and the pipeline points the same way: Palantir closed a record $1.31B of U.S. commercial contract value in the quarter, up 342% YoY, taking remaining deal value to $3.63B, up 199%.
takeaways.title: U.S. commercial is exploding

takeaways.text: Revenue grew 63% while adjusted operating income reached $601M — a 51% margin. Added together, that is Palantir's 'Rule of 40' score of 114%, and U.S. revenue overall grew 77% to $883M.
takeaways.title: A Rule of 40 score of 114

takeaways.text: Adjusted free cash flow was $540M — 46% of revenue — and Palantir raised its full-year guidance for U.S. commercial revenue (to over $1.43B) and for free cash flow (to $1.9–2.1B).
takeaways.title: Cash generation followed

verdict: Palantir grew revenue 63% to $1.18B as U.S. commercial sales jumped 121%, and kept $476M as profit — a 40% margin — helped by $87M of interest and other income and a tax bill of just $4M.
